TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR FINANCES WITH FINRUP

Finrup is the powerful yet simple expense tracker and budget manager that helps you manage money effortlessly. Track spending, monitor income, set financial goals, and gain complete control over your personal finances—all in one beautifully designed app.

■ APPLE INTELLIGENCE POWERED
• Smart category suggestions using Apple Intelligence
• Get personalized expense categorization
• Intelligent insights for better financial decisions
• Easy onboarding with AI-guided setup

■ SMART BUDGET MANAGEMENT
• Set monthly and yearly budgets for any category
• Get intelligent budget suggestions based on your spending history
• Smart suggestions analyze transaction trends using advanced statistical methods
• Visual progress indicators show budget usage at a glance
• Over-budget warnings help you stay on track
• Budget tracking for both income and expense categories
• Multi-currency budget support

■ SIRI & SHORTCUTS INTEGRATION
• Add expenses with Siri voice commands
• Create custom shortcuts for recurring transactions
• Check account balances hands-free
• Quick transaction logging on the go

■ POWERFUL EXPENSE TRACKING
• Track all income and expenses instantly
• Categorize spending with custom categories & subcategories
• Attach notes and details to every transaction
• Fast search through your entire transaction history
• Multi-currency support with conversion tracking

■ ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
• Manage unlimited accounts (bank, cash, credit cards, investments)
• Track balances across all accounts in real-time
• Support for multiple currencies
• Import/export data easily
• Complete backup and restore functionality

■ SMART BUDGETING & GOALS
• Set and track financial goals
• Monitor goal progress with visual insights
• Plan for savings, debt reduction, or major purchases
• Stay motivated with achievement tracking

■ RECURRING TRANSACTIONS
• Set up automatic recurring income/expenses
• Never forget regular bills or subscriptions
• Manage scheduled transactions effortlessly
• Edit or skip occurrences as needed

■ MULTIPLE PROFILES
• Create separate profiles for personal, business, or family
• Switch between profiles instantly
• Keep finances organized and separated
• Perfect for freelancers and small business owners

■ FAVORITES & QUICK ACCESS
• Favorite frequently used transactions, accounts, and categories
• Quick access to your most important items in one place
• Organized favorites list grouped by type
• Home screen widgets for qu

show_hn.title: Show HN: Finrup – a free, offline-first personal finance app for iOS

quotes.text:
For past few years, I went through multiple option and some didn't work for me because of privacy concern, some didn't work for me because I missed some feature and I had fallen back to number spreadsheet and spreadsheet formulas. I wanted a personal finance app that works offline, stays simple, and doesn’t rely on external servers. Most apps I tried required accounts, subscriptions, or bank integrations. I wanted something closer to a local notebook: fast manual entry, clear summaries, and full control over where the data lives. So I built Finrup as a solo project.

Finrup is an iOS app for manual expense tracking. All data is stored locally on the device. The only sync option is iCloud, used purely for backup and multi-device continuity.

No backend, no ads, no analytics, no tracking SDKs, no signup, no subscriptions.

Things I focused on:
- Offline-first by design
- Privacy-preserving (data never leaves the Apple ecosystem)
- Manual entry on purpose (no bank APIs or aggregators)
- Completely free

The goal was to keep the feature set small and the behavior predictable, instead of turning it into a dashboard-heavy system that needs constant data ingestion.

To try it, you can download from the App Store and start using it immediately — no setup required. You can also go through guide at https://amritghimire.com/tech/finrup-expense-tracking-guide to see how to use.
